narrative.details: Now that you have gathered all of the Warlord cards together into a deck, a ninth card mysteriously appears with the same backing as the first eight.   On this card is inscribed, "Return these cards to the Darkmoon Faire and be rewarded."   You have heard that this faire alternately stops at Mulgore and Goldshire every few months, so you will have to wait until they are here next.
narrative.objectives: Return the Warlords Deck to the Darkmoon Faire when it comes to town.
narrative.offerRewardText: So you have put together a deck of Warlords.   Your gesture of returning it to us will create a tie between you and the Darkmoon that will not soon be forgotten.   Allow me to present you with one of the greater darkmoon cards as a small token of our appreciation.
narrative.requestItemsText: I see that you have managed to complete a deck of warlords!   Congratulations!
